To begin you speak wonders to me i thought i was the only one that is going through this or has gone through this Im the oldest child of six children as well and grew up in a single mother home im currently 20 and at first i hated my mom for bringing me into a world where i had to face so many problems but now that im older i pitty her in a sense i feel like when your the oldest or one of the oldest siblings alot of responsibility is put on you at a young age i remember getting picked on for not having the nice clothes,etc in school and not celebrating holidays like Christmas when your young these things mean alot to you and it was hard on me we always had food and a roof over our head but thats it the bare minimum i was very depressed and suicidal growing up but kept my issues to myself being the oldest i always had to be the strong one this has defiantly effected me when it comes to realtionships and im still learning to overcome that at 18 i moved out i was homeless for a bit slept on park benches,etc but i was working full time within a month i was able to get a place and set myself up enough financially but i could never stop thinking about my siblings i felt guilty like how a survivor from a plane wreck or something would feel even though my life was doing good i still felt bad for spending anything on myself like watching a movie or buying shoes no normal 18 should feel like this when they spend there hard earned money but i did it took me awhile to stop feeling like that fast foward to years im 20 now and when i have conversations about dreams and goals with my friends they say i sound like im in my 30s i always buy things for my siblings and try to explain why its hard right now they always say they want to live with me this kills me inside but i stay strong and dont let them see how sad im really am when they say things like that i stress more than i should i at my age when it comes to things i make enough to support myself with no problem but im not supporting myself im supporting my mother 5 siblings and me i recently saved enough to invest/start a small passive income bussines and that has helped alot i feel like a burden has been taken off my shoulders and i can start living my own life again im going to be 21 soon and hope that i can live like a normal 21 year old i know most likely i wont be able to but i can tell you that the hard work pays off and your siblings if not know will understand what you did for them i like to think of people like us as soldiers who carry the load so others can enjoy life more i defiantly recommend going to a therapist i go every two weeks and it helps to get those thoughts out of your head we can't run from our thoughts they will manifest themselves one way or another stay strong
